# Siddhartha Vanasthali School Redesign Demo

This repository contains an independent historical frontend redesign concept inspired by the Siddhartha Vanasthali school website.

## Important status

- This is not the official school website.
- It is not an admissions portal.
- It is not an authorized source for fees, notices, calendars, results, transport, staff, policies, or contact information.
- Content and links may be old, incomplete, or placeholder material.
- Do not submit student, parent, identity, payment, or academic information through this demo.

Use the school's official, independently verified communication channels for current information and services.

## Technology

- Static HTML
- SCSS and compiled CSS
- Vanilla JavaScript
- Gulp workflow
- Glide.js
- Scroll-Out.js

## Repository

https://github.com/Nischhalsubba/Siddhartha-Vanasthali-School
